optIn.subtitle: Enable DMs only on devices where you want them active.

point.events: DMs use Nostr encrypted direct-message events.
point.subscriptions: Enabling DMs may open DM relay subscriptions and decrypt/display conversations for this device/session.
point.device: Leave DMs off if you do not want DM traffic or notifications on this device.

title: Direct Messages
clearCacheTitle: Clear DM cache (no-op in this build)
clearCacheAlert: DM cache wipe is local-only; this client keeps DMs in memory only. Refresh to clear.
noFollows: None of your follows have messaged you yet
everyoneInFollows: Everyone you've messaged is in Follows

protocol.label: Message protocol
protocol.nip17Title: Default: sealed and gift-wrapped, attachments included
protocol.nip04Explain: NIP-04 is for older clients that only speak it. Relays can see who is talking to whom and when, and attachments are off.

compose.noRecentDescription: Paste an npub above and tap Next.

emptyMobileDescription: Tap + to start an encrypted DM with anyone on Nostr.
pickConversation: Pick or start a DM conversation.
emptyEncrypted: No messages yet. Send the first one, end-to-end encrypted.

file.integrity: This file doesn't match what was sent
file.needsNip17: Encrypted files need NIP-17 for this conversation

raw.title: Raw event
raw.rumorHint: The message itself (kind {kind}), as only you and the other person can read it. It is unsigned on purpose: the seal inside the gift wrap is what proves who sent it.
raw.wrapHint: What relays store: a gift wrap (kind 1059) signed by a one-time key. Relays see only who it is addressed to, not the sender, the time, or the content.
raw.nip04Hint: A legacy NIP-04 direct message (kind 4). The content is encrypted, but sender, recipient and time are visible to every relay.
raw.keyWarning: Contains the file's decryption key: anyone you give this JSON to can open the file.
raw.unavailable: Not available for this message yet.
